Identifies the administrator who performed the moderation action.

Report that led to the action, if any.

moderation_actions_report_fk — FOREIGN KEY (report_id) REFERENCES safety.reports(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. Nullable; a moderation action may be linked to a safety report.

Records the standardized reason for taking the moderation action against the user.
A named CHECK constraint validates reason_code against the database's allowed reason codes. The value must match one of the permitted codes; it cannot be an arbitrary non-empty value.
Is the action still in force?
Tracks whether the moderation action is active, expired, or reversed.
moderation_actions_status_ck — CHECK (status IN ('active', 'expired', 'reversed')). An expired action requires expires_at. A reversed action requires reversed_at and reversed_by_admin_id.
Provides the creation timestamp for audit and chronological queries.
NOT NULL. DEFAULT now(). Records when the moderation action was created. Used for action history and chronological tracking.
Date and time; NULL = permanent / not timed
Records when a time-limited moderation action ends.

moderation_actions_expires_at_ck — expires_at must be NULL or later than created_at. Temporary moderation actions require an expiry time. permanent_suspension must have expires_at IS NULL. An expired action requires expires_at to be NOT NULL.
Date and time; NULL unless reversed
Records when an earlier moderation action was reversed.
moderation_actions_reversed_at_ck — reversed_at must be NULL or greater than or equal to created_at. When status = 'reversed', reversed_at and reversed_by_admin_id must both be NOT NULL.
Identifies the administrator who reversed the action.

moderation_actions_reversed_by_admin_fk — FOREIGN KEY (reversed_by_admin_id) REFERENCES safety.admin_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. When an action is reversed, the reversal must be performed by an active security_admin, and an approved appeal must exist for the same moderation_action_id. Links the appeal to the specific moderation action being challenged.

moderation_appeals_action_fk — FOREIGN KEY (moderation_action_id) REFERENCES safety.moderation_actions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. Each appeal references an existing moderation action. The current database does not enforce a one-open-appeal-per-action partial unique index.
Identifies the user who submitted the appeal.
moderation_appeals_appellant_fk — FOREIGN KEY (appellant_user_id) REFERENCES core.users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. The appellant must reference an existing user account.
Tracks the appeal review lifecycle from submission through review to approval or rejection.
moderation_appeals_status_ck — CHECK (status IN ('submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected')). submitted and under_review are pending states; approved and rejected are final decision states.
Free text; NULL allowed. No database CHECK enforces a 2,000-character maximum.

Free text; NULL allowed. No database CHECK enforces a 2,000-character maximum.
Administrator assigned to review the appeal.

NULL while submitted or under_review; appeal_accepted when approved; original_action_upheld when rejected.
Why the appeal was decided this way.

moderation_appeals_decision_ck — submitted and under_review require decision_reason_code IS NULL and decided_at IS NULL. approved requires appeal_accepted and decided_at NOT NULL. rejected requires original_action_upheld and decided_at NOT NULL.

NOT NULL. DEFAULT now(). Records when the appeal was submitted. moderation_appeals_time_ck ensures decided_at is NULL or >= created_at.

User whose data is on hold.
Links the legal hold to the account whose records must be preserved.
FK to core.users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. legal_holds_user_id_ix — INDEX (user_id).
Legal / safety case this hold belongs to.
Groups related legal-hold records under a traceable case identifier.
legal_holds_case_reference_ck — CHECK (case_reference ~ '^LH-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}$'). The reference must follow the format LH-YYYY-NNNN, for example LH-2026-0001.
specified_user_accounts, specified_content_items, specified_communications, access_and_security_logs, transaction_records, moderation_and_appeal_history
Which kind of data must be preserved.
Defines which classes of records are covered by the hold.
legal_holds_scope_ck — CHECK constraint restricts scope to the six permitted values listed above.
block_account_erasure, block_content_deletion, block_message_deletion, block_media_deletion, block_data_job_purge, preserve_audit_logs, preserve_moderation_records, freeze_account_status_change
What the system must NOT do while the hold is active.
Tells account-erasure and data-deletion workflows which operations must be blocked during the hold.
legal_holds_restricted_actions_ck — CHECK constraint requires at least one restricted action and permits only the eight values listed above.
Tracks whether the legal hold is active, released, or expired.

legal_holds_status_ck — CHECK constraint permits active, released, and expired. legal_holds_release_fields_ck validates the required release fields for each status. Active holds have no release details; released holds require released_at, released_by_admin_id, and release_reason_code; expired holds require effective_until and no release details.
Identifies the administrator who imposed the hold.

legal_holds_imposed_admin_fk — FOREIGN KEY (imposed_by_admin_id) REFERENCES safety.admin_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. Only an active security_admin can impose a legal hold, validated by legal_holds_admin_validation_trg. No authority_level requirement applies.
97 codes in 24 groups - see Value Lists
Records the standardized reason for imposing the legal hold.

legal_holds_reason_code_ck — CHECK constraint validates reason_code against the approved database list of permitted values. The value 'other' requires reason_note to be provided, enforced by legal_holds_reason_note_ck.
Captures a short explanation when the selected reason requires additional context.
NULL unless the selected reason requires explanation

legal_holds_reason_note_ck — reason_note is required when reason_code = 'other'. legal_holds_reason_note_length_ck — CHECK (reason_note IS NULL OR char_length(reason_note) <= 500). Maximum length: 500 characters.
NOT NULL. DEFAULT now(). Records the date and time when the legal hold was imposed. legal_holds_effective_until_ck requires effective_until to be NULL or >= imposed_at.
Date/time; NULL means no planned end date.
Records the planned end time, if the hold is time-limited.

legal_holds_effective_until_ck — CHECK (effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until >= imposed_at). NULL means the legal hold has no planned end date. If provided, the date must be equal to or later than imposed_at.
Date and time; NULL while active
Records when the hold was released.
legal_holds_release_fields_ck — For status = 'released', released_at must be NOT NULL and >= imposed_at. For status = 'active' or 'expired', released_at must be NULL.
Identifies the administrator who released the hold.

legal_holds_released_admin_fk — FOREIGN KEY (released_by_admin_id) REFERENCES safety.admin_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT. Only an active security_admin can release a legal hold, validated by legal_holds_admin_validation_trg. This field is NULL until the hold is released. No authority_level requirement applies.

CREATE TABLE safety.moderation_appeals (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    moderation_action_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    appellant_user_id UUID NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted',
    statement TEXT,
    reviewer_admin_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    decision_reason_code VARCHAR(60),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    decided_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    CONSTRAINT moderation_appeals_pkey
        PRIMARY KEY (id),

    CONSTRAINT moderation_appeals_action_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (moderation_action_id)
        REFERENCES safety.moderation_actions(id)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT,

    CONSTRAINT moderation_appeals_appellant_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (appellant_user_id)
        REFERENCES core.users(user_id)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT,

    CONSTRAINT moderation_appeals_reviewer_fk
        FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_admin_id)
        REFERENCES safety.admin_users(id)
        ON DELETE RESTRICT,

    CONSTRAINT moderation_appeals_status_ck
        CHECK (status IN ('submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected')),

    CONSTRAINT moderation_appeals_decision_ck
        CHECK (
            (status IN ('submitted', 'under_review')
             AND decision_reason_code IS NULL
             AND decided_at IS NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'approved'
             AND decision_reason_code = 'appeal_accepted'
             AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)
            OR
            (status = 'rejected'
             AND decision_reason_code = 'original_action_upheld'
             AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)
        ),

    CONSTRAINT moderation_appeals_time_ck
        CHECK (decided_at IS NULL OR decided_at >= created_at)
);
